# Glo Medspa

> Glo Medspa is a medical spa in Scottsdale, Arizona, founded in 2013 by Charles Small, BSN, RN. It offers injectables, laser and skin treatments, facials, body contouring and wellness services, with a natural-results, no-pressure philosophy. Clients are seen by appointment. New clients receive 10% off all services.

## Contact

- Address: 10505 N 69th St #1000, Scottsdale, AZ 85253
- Phone: (480) 245-6881

- Hours: By appointment

## Team

- Charles Small, BSN, RN — Founder and injector; 15 years of critical care experience; basic and advanced certifications in Botox and Juvederm injection techniques; member, Dermatology Nurses' Association and American Society of Plastic Surgical Nurses
- Ewelina — Lead Esthetician
- Tara — Nurse Injector; over nine years of experience across critical care, surgery and plastics, including a tenure at the Mayo Clinic
- Rachel — Front Desk and Office Manager

## Services

- Injectables: Botox, Dysport, Letybo, dermal fillers (lip, cheek, chin, jaw, tear trough, smile line), liquid rhinoplasty, PDO threads, Kybella
- Laser & Skin: Nouvaderm laser, Forma skin tightening, microneedling, eMatrix, photo facial
- Facials & Body: Hydrafacial, Fire & Ice Facial, Honey Enzyme Facial, microdermabrasion, dermaplaning, VelaShape body contouring, TruSculpt iD, Morpheus8, Perfect Peel, liquid facelift
- Wellness: B12 shots, MIC injections, filler dissolve (hyaluronidase)
